title: How to Send Money Abroad With Remitly for Thanksgiving
summary: Sending money abroad for Thanksgiving? See how to send with Remitly and plan around delivery estimates, fees, and holiday hours.
body_markdown:
***Quick answer:** To send money abroad for Thanksgiving, sign in to Remitly, select your recipient’s country, and enter the amount you want to send. Choose an available delivery method, then review the fee, exchange rate, amount your recipient will get, and estimated delivery time before confirming. U.S. Thanksgiving falls on Thursday, November 26, in 2026. If your recipient needs the money by a specific time, plan around when they’ll be able to access it.*


**[Thanksgiving in the U.S.](https://www.remitly.com/blog/lifestyle-culture/thanksgiving-celebration/) often means helping family abroad in some way. Maybe your parents need extra cash for groceries, or you want to cover a family dinner from across the ocean. Whatever the reason, two questions matter most: when does your recipient actually need the money, and how will they receive it?**


**Your recipient’s day doesn’t run on your schedule. If they’re several[time zones](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/confusing-time-zones-for-international-money-transfers/) ahead, they may need funds earlier in their day than you’d expect from a typical U.S. Thursday. Planning around their timeline, not just yours, makes the difference between a smooth transfer and a last-minute scramble.**


**This guide walks through sending money with Remitly for Thanksgiving, what to check before you confirm a transfer, and how to plan around the holiday.**


## Can you send money abroad on Thanksgiving Day?


Yes,[you can start a transfer online](http://www.remitly.com/) or in the[Remitly app](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/mobile-app) on Thanksgiving Day. But delivery timing depends on several factors: your recipient’s destination, how you’re paying, how they’re receiving the funds, and whether the transfer requires any additional verification checks.


Thanksgiving is a[U.S. federal holiday](https://www.remitly.com/blog/lifestyle-culture/us-federal-holidays/) , and[some U.S. payment processing schedules change on this day](https://www.frbservices.org/about/holiday-schedules/) . If your recipient is picking up cash, their local pickup location’s hours matter too, since those won’t necessarily follow U.S. holiday closures. For the clearest picture, always check the delivery estimate shown for your specific transfer before you confirm it.


## How to send money abroad with Remitly for Thanksgiving


Sending money with Remitly is simple. Here’s how it works:


1. **Sign in or create an account** in the[Remitly app](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/mobile-app) or on[Remitly.com](https://www.remitly.com/) .
2. **Select the receiving country and enter the amount.** If you’re covering a specific expense, check how much your recipient will actually get in their local currency.
3. **Choose an available delivery method.** Depending on the destination, you may be able to use bank deposit, cash pickup, or mobile wallet. Ask your recipient which option works best for them before you choose.
4. **Enter the recipient’s details and select a payment method.** If they’re picking up cash, double-check that their name matches their government-issued ID exactly.
5. **Review the transfer before confirming.** Check the fee, exchange rate, total amount you’ll pay, amount your recipient will get, and the estimated delivery time.
6. **Track the transfer after sending.** Open it in the Remitly app or on the website to[see the latest status](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/how-to-track-your-money-transfer-with-the-remitly-app/) . For cash pickup, share the pickup instructions with your recipient and let them know as soon as the money is ready.


## **What should I check before sending money for Thanksgiving?**


A few minutes of planning can save a lot of stress on the day itself. Use this checklist before you hit confirm:


**If your recipient…** **Check before you send**


Needs the money before a meal or shopping trip Ask for their deadline in local time, and leave room beyond the estimated delivery time.


Plans to collect cash Confirm the pickup location, its opening hours, and ID requirements. Leave enough time for them to travel there after the transfer is ready.


Prefers bank deposit or mobile wallet Confirm the account or wallet details, and check the delivery estimate for that specific option.


Needs a specific amount in local currency Review what they’ll receive alongside what you’ll pay, including any transfer fee.


For example, if your family plans to shop for Thanksgiving dinner Thursday morning, treat that shopping trip as your real deadline. If they’re collecting cash, build in time for them to travel to the pickup location and complete the pickup before heading to the store.


## Thanksgiving money transfer FAQs


### How early should I send money for Thanksgiving?


Start by confirming when your recipient actually needs to use the money. Check the delivery estimate for your chosen payment and delivery methods, then build in extra time if the deadline matters to them.


### How much does it cost to send money with Remitly for Thanksgiving?


The cost of your transfer depends on the destination, your payment method, and the delivery option you choose. Before you confirm any transfer, Remitly shows you the fee, the exchange rate, and the exact amount your recipient will get, so there are no surprises.


### Do money transfers go through on Thanksgiving?


Transfers can be started on Thanksgiving Day, but delivery depends on your destination, payment method, and delivery option. Some U.S. payment processing schedules shift around the holiday, so check the delivery estimate for your specific transfer rather than assuming standard timing applies.


### What should I do if my Thanksgiving transfer is delayed?


Open the transfer in the Remitly app or on the website to check its latest status and delivery information. Look for any[instructions from Remitly about next steps](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/help/article/transfer-on-hold) . If you still need help,[Remitly’s support team is available](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/help) through the app.


## Send with confidence this Thanksgiving


**Thanksgiving is about being with the people you love, even when distance gets in the way. Checking your recipient’s deadline, confirming their preferred delivery method, and reviewing your transfer details before you send gives you one less thing to worry about on a busy holiday.**


**Sending money to someone you’re thinking of this Thanksgiving? Choose their country in[Remitly](http://www.remitly.com/) to see your delivery options, transfer cost, and estimated arrival time before you send.**
